messages.text: Welcome! Our members made 300% last month
Guaranteed 2x in a month. VIP only
Everyone buys XYZ at 9:00 sharp. Tell no one
How do you know it will go up?

steps.title: 리딩방 · leading room
steps.body: Paid chat rooms that sell “sure” stock tips. Korea's financial regulator has warned about them many times. Some leaders buy first, hype the stock to members, then sell into the rise. That is a [[pump-and-dump]].

steps.prompt: Swipe each message: is it a red flag or information?

items.text: The company reported higher revenue this quarter
The share price fell 12% this year
Everyone is buying, don't miss out
Pay ₩990,000 to join the VIP room
The annual report lists the company's debts

steps.explanation: Red flags rush you, promise certain gains or ask you to pay for access. Information can be checked and doesn't tell you what to do.

steps.prompt: Which message is the strongest warning sign?
options: “Prices can go down as well as up”
steps.explanation: No investment can guarantee a return. A promise of certain gains is the most common sign of a scam.

steps.prompt: Why would a room leader want all members to buy at the same minute?
options: Their buying pushes the price up, so the leader can sell high
steps.explanation: When many members buy at once, the price jumps. A leader who bought earlier sells to them at that higher price. When the buying stops, the price falls back.
